config.assignment: fixed original 140-cell order; cell index modulo worker count
config.forecast: max of three per-cell training times within each fixed worker partition; max worker sum plus measured maximum process/tree-setup overhead, then 2x; no ideal CPU-count division
config.reference_gate: all 1260 cell endpoints match all stable state/RNG/work fields in the pinned serial node profile; retain failures before forecasts
config.scope: independent-cell scheduling only; all 140 cells/seeds/rules/work fixed; no score/default/strength/global/learning admission
